thread:
ryan: Heads-up: support ticket about several 1-3 token dupes after a retry + route fallback during streaming + toolcall.
kim: logs?
ryan: session=sg-77, trace=sg-77-2026. snippet:
```
2026-03-22T09:11:02Z REQ session=sg-77 route=us-east prefix_tokens=21
2026-03-22T09:11:04Z STREAM_TRUNC session=sg-77 trunc_tokens=2 provisional_emitted=true tag=rt-45
2026-03-22T09:11:04Z TOOLCALL start session=sg-77 tool=embed
2026-03-22T09:11:05Z ROUTE_FALLBACK session=sg-77 to=us-lowcost
2026-03-22T09:11:06Z STREAM_RESUME session=sg-77 resumed_tokens=23 confirmed=true confirm_ref=rt-45
2026-03-22T09:11:07Z BILL provisional: 21+2 route=us-east
2026-03-22T09:11:08Z BILL confirmed: 23 route=us-lowcost
```
ryan: UI shows provisional 23 + confirmed 23 -> user sees ~46. net should be 23 (stream) + tool tokens.
alec: looks like provisional tag rt-45 didn't survive the fallback across systems, so ledger kept both provisional and confirmed as independent charges.
kim: is the tag present in the confirmer path? maybe routing layer strips it when we handoff to fallback region.
tara: quick mitigation: update routing to preserve any provisional tag in the handoff payload (small change). long-term we should use a reconcile_tag that is session-scoped and honored by all layers.
ops: billing-bot: Alert: provisional_confirm_mismatch detected for session=sg-77 delta=2 tokens
alec: proposal: add a lightweight reconcile_tag generated on first provisional that is propagated in request headers and stored with provisional ledger row. confirmer looks up by reconcile_tag first, and if found, collapses provisional+confirmed into a single reconciled row. keep original_route metadata so analytics can still attribute.
kim: agree. also need to handle multiple provisional emits (multiple truncations) before confirm. reconcile_tag must allow accumulate semantics (list of provisional ids or a single group id).
ryan: UI impact: console should default to showing net_tokens but allow expanding to see provisional and confirmed lines. add a reconciled_id column in exports.
tara: tests: simulate: truncation -> toolcall -> fallback -> resume, and truncation x2 -> resume partial confirm. add e2e.
alec: backfill: run a job to find confirmed events where a provisional exists with same session and overlapping time window but different route; reconcile them and generate adjustments. ops can run per-customer.
ops: I'll queue a backfill for the impacted account and hold from auto-refund until result.
billing-bot: Info: backfill_job_enqueued id=bf-20260322-1
ryan: owners: tara (routing header), alec (confirmer + ledger reconcile), kim (console + export). I'll open small PRs.
kim: PR for console change will add net_tokens column and an expand toggle; won't change raw CSV but will add reconciled_id column.
tara: PR to keep header on handoff today. tagging @ops for rollout.
alec: I'll draft the confirmer patch and a backfill script. we should also emit metric provisional_tag_mismatch_rate.
ryan: thanks. please post PR links and I'll update the support ticket.
